prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” digital marketing agency — the right one depends on your business, goals, budget, and preferred working style. I can help pick the best fit for you, but first I need a few details.

Quick questions
- What type of business are you (B2B, B2C, e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, local service, franchise, etc.)?
- What are your top goals (lead generation, brand awareness, traffic, sales, app installs, conversions, SEO, paid media, social)?
- Monthly budget range for marketing/agencies?
- Do you prefer a local agency in St. Louis you can meet in person, or is remote OK?
- Any must-have services (website build, SEO, PPC, social, content, analytics, CRO)?
- Timeline and whether you need a long-term partner or a short-term project?

How I can help next
- If you give the answers above, I’ll shortlist 3–5 St. Louis agencies that match your needs and give pros/cons for each (experience, specialties, estimated cost range, what to ask them).
- Or I can provide a short evaluation checklist and sample RFP/questions to send to agencies so you can compare proposals.

Quick evaluation checklist (use when vetting agencies)
- Relevant experience in your industry and similar-sized clients
- Case studies and measurable results (traffic, leads, conversion rate improvements)
- Clear offerings and pricing model (monthly retainer vs. project vs. performance)
- Reporting cadence & KPIs they’ll track
- Team structure (who will do the work vs. account manager)
- Contract terms and cancellation policy
- References you can call

Which way do you want to proceed — give me your business details and I’ll build a tailored shortlist, or would you like the vetting/RFP template first?
